About Me

Hi, I'm Fopix168YT — a passionate Roblox developer and world builder dedicated to creating unique, immersive experiences.

From dark horror dungeons to vibrant low-poly open worlds, I bring varied aesthetics and gameplay concepts to life using Roblox Studio.

Every project is built with attention to atmosphere, detail, and player experience — whether it's a peaceful cherry blossom garden or a terrifying haunted forest.
